title: Meta's India offices hit by opposition protests over account removals
paragraphs: Meta's India offices hit by opposition protests over account removals
Debate is growing in India about potential risks to free speech from the increasingly strict efforts of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government to remove social media content it objects to.

NEW DELHI: The youth wing of India's main opposition Congress party clashed with police outside Meta offices, protesting the company's removal of some Instagram accounts of its members, according to footage released by the group on Saturday (Nov 21).
